name: Maverick Analyzer - Rico
desc: If this card is Normal Summon: You can Special Summon 1 "Maverick Hunter" monster from your Deck but negate it's effect. If this card is in your GY: You can banish both this card and 1 "Maverick Hunter" monster you control or in your GY; Special Summon 1 "Maverick Hunter" Synchro monster from your Extra Deck whose level's is equal to the combine of the banished monster's level (This is treated as Synchro Summon). You can only use 1 effect of "Maverick Analyzer - RICO" once per turn.
strings: Special Summon Synchro monster from Extra Deck
